integrity: The finite claim is established by an exact deterministic prime-valuation invariant and an exhaustive traversal. A direct recomputation is included on 1002 selected small inputs. The packaged checker source and recorded output are included.
scientific_limitations: The result is finite: it verifies \(3\le n\le 10^8\) and makes no claim for larger \(n\). Search-based originality checking cannot exclude unindexed prior computations.
title: A hundred-million-term verification of the factorial-over-three refactorable conjecture
